trial_court: Court of MS. ANJANI MAHAJAN, CIVIL JUDGE−10 (CENTRAL), TIS HAZARI COURTS, DELHI - Suit No. 380/08
case_name: Mr. Karan Nath vs . Mr. Kailash Nath & Ors.

parties.respondent_defendant: Mr. Kailash Nath & Ors. (father, daughters, wife of defendant no.1)

facts_of_case: The plaintiff filed a suit for declaration, rendition of accounts, and permanent injunction against the defendants, claiming equal rights in the Hindu Undivided Family property as the son of defendant no.1.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement between parties to a suit cannot be reagitated in another suit.
legal_principles.held: The issue regarding rights of the property in the suit had been settled and a compromise decree has been passed on the basis of settlement. Therefore, the plaintiff was precluded in law from challenging the compromise decree.
cited_cases: Mr. Karan Nath vs . Mr. Kailash Nath & Ors., (2014)

legal_principles.principle: A plaintiff cannot challenge a compromise decree in another suit.
legal_principles.held: The issue regarding rights of the property in the suit had been settled and a compromise decree has been passed on the basis of settlement. Therefore, the plaintiff was precluded in law from challenging the compromise decree.
cited_cases: Mr. Karan Nath vs . Mr. Kailash Nath & Ors., (2014)

outcome.final_order: The court granted the plaintiff's application to withdraw the suit with liberty to file a fresh suit.
